import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Survival Rate by Class and Sex
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_by_class_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], width=0.7)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax1.legend(title='Sex', title_fontsize=10)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Age Distribution by Survival
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
df_age = df.dropna(subset=['age'])
ax2.hist([df_age[df_age['survived']==0]['age'], df_age[df_age['survived']==1]['age']], 
         bins=20, label=['Did not survive', 'Survived'], color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11)
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Fare Distribution by Class
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
df_fare = df[df['fare'] < 300]  # Remove outliers for better visualization
sns.boxplot(data=df_fare, x='class', y='fare', ax=ax3, palette='Set2', order=['First', 'Second', 'Third'])
ax3.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Fare', fontsize=11)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Survival Rate by Embarked Port
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
df_embarked = df.dropna(subset=['embarked'])
survival_embarked = df_embarked.groupby('embarked')['survived'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
colors_embarked = ['#FFB6C1', '#87CEEB', '#98D8C8']
bars = ax4.bar(survival_embarked.index, survival_embarked['mean'], color=colors_embarked, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2)
ax4.set_title('Survival Rate by Port of Embarkation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Port', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, survival_embarked['count'])):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.02, f'n={count}', 
             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 5. Family Size vs Survival
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].mean()
ax5.plot(family_survival.index, family_survival.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=8, color='#FF6B6B', markerfacecolor='#4ECDC4', markeredgewidth=2)
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Family Size', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=11)
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3)
ax5.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 6. Overall Statistics
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
stats_data = [
    ['Overall Survival Rate', f"{df['survived'].mean():.1%}"],
    ['Male Survival Rate', f"{df[df['sex']=='male']['survived'].mean():.1%}"],
    ['Female Survival Rate', f"{df[df['sex']=='female']['survived'].mean():.1%}"],
    ['1st Class Survival', f"{df[df['pclass']==1]['survived'].mean():.1%}"],
    ['2nd Class Survival', f"{df[df['pclass']==2]['survived'].mean():.1%}"],
    ['3rd Class Survival', f"{df[df['pclass']==3]['survived'].mean():.1%}"],
    ['Children (<18) Survival', f"{df[df['age']<18]['survived'].mean():.1%}"],
    ['Adults (≥18) Survival', f"{df[df['age']>=18]['survived'].mean():.1%}"]
]

ax6.axis('tight')
ax6.axis('off')
table = ax6.table(cellText=stats_data, colLabels=['Metric', 'Value'], 
                  cellLoc='left', loc='center',
                  colWidths=[0.6, 0.2])
table.auto_set_font_size(False)
table.set_fontsize(11)
table.scale(1, 2)
for i in range(len(stats_data) + 1):
    if i == 0:
        table[(i, 0)].set_facecolor('#D3D3D3')
        table[(i, 1)].set_facecolor('#D3D3D3')
        table[(i, 0)].set_text_props(weight='bold')
        table[(i, 1)].set_text_props(weight='bold')
    else:
        table[(i, 0)].set_facecolor('#F0F0F0')
        table[(i, 1)].set_facecolor('#E8F4F8')

plt.suptitle('Titanic Disaster: Comprehensive Survival Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
